description:
Original song for HATSUNE MIKU: COLORFUL STAGE! to celebrate KAITO's anniversary 🍨
https://flavorfoley.com/EWZ ⬅️ Streaming, offvocal, etc
– 
🍳 JamieP: happy freaking birthday business boy KAITO!!!! ah, mondays... before i started doing music full-time, i worked a really godawful job at (insert godawful american retail chain here), and it was... my only actual job i've ever had... but boy oh boy would i sit there listening to the same five 7 year old pop songs on loop for like eight hours every single day while scanning price tags for markdowns. and dream about just leaving and doing Literally Anything Else. i may not have been white collar or anything but boy do i understand the impulse. i love you KAITO i hope you make some mildly bad decisions on the dancefloor tonight

🍳 Vane Lily: HAPPY BIRTHDAY KAITO I LOVE YOU KAITO are you free tonight lets get married i mean married i mean married i mean married i mean married i mean are you free tonight are you free on mondays. i'll be your mildly bad decision tonight.

🍳 rice: Happy birthday, KAITO !!!!!!! Do you have time to connect KAITO!!!!! I'll put some time on the calendar KAITO!!!!!!!! Let's quit our nine to fives together KAITO!!!!!!! I love you KAITO

😈 CircusP: "Can my collaborator comment be emojis? If so I want floating business man emoji and confetti ball"
– 
Art by 🍳reverieque x 😈ricedeity
reverieque: ":D thank you so much to flavor foley for approaching me to work on this!! this song is so funky and it was wonderful collaborating with rice on the art. i haven't made something this rainbow-y in a while and it was so cool!!! to the reader, i love you and i hope you're having a nice day"
ricedeity: "I love you KAITO (a second time)"

Video by ricedeity also but they're trying to be lowkey about it
